definitions.explanation: A musical wind instrument, especially traditional Japanese flutes.
An instrument that makes a shrill sound when blown.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{笛|ふえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえた→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧。
examples.english: I heard the sound of flutes at the festival.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ころ→頃：03091_koro⟧、⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{縦笛|たてぶえ}→縦笛：22668_tatebue⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}った→習う：00479_narau⟧。
examples.english: When I was a child, I learned the recorder at school.
examples.notes: ⟦{縦笛|たてぶえ}→縦笛：22668_tatebue⟧ = recorder (vertical flute)

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{竹|たけ}→竹：02220_take⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{笛|ふえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{孫|まご}→孫：03731_mago⟧たち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{作|つく}って→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather was good at making flutes from bamboo and often made them for his grandchildren.

examples.japanese: ⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧な⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遠|とお}く→遠く：01680_tooku⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{聞|き}こえて→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧くる{笛|ふえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{音色|ねいろ}→音色：07422_neiro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦どこか→どこか：02361_dokoka⟧⟦{懐|なつ}かしい→懐かしい：02484_natsukashii⟧⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：01385_kimochi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦させる→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The tone of a flute heard from afar on a quiet night makes you feel somehow nostalgic.

examples.japanese: ⟦{審判|しんぱん}→審判：03331_shinpan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{笛|ふえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吹|ふ}いて→吹く：02445_fuku⟧⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{止|と}めた→止める：00678_tomeru⟧。
examples.english: The referee blew the whistle and stopped the match.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警察官|けいさつかん}→警察官：05056_keisatsukan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{交差点|こうさてん}→交差点：01404_kousaten⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{笛|ふえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吹|ふ}いて→吹く：02445_fuku⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{止|と}めた→止める：00678_tomeru⟧。
examples.english: The police officer blew a whistle at the intersection to stop the cars.

examples.japanese: ⟦{体育|たいいく}→体育：03384_taiiku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{笛|ふえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吹|ふ}く→吹く：02445_fuku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{生徒|せいと}→生徒：01051_seito⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦やめて→やめる：00909_yameru⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: When the PE teacher blew the whistle, the students stopped running and gathered together.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦とき→時：02918_toki⟧、⟦{助|たす}け→助け：07777_tasuke⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}ぶ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{防災|ぼうさい}→防災：07907_bousai⟧⟦{用|よう}→用：noentry⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{笛|ふえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦おく→置く：01092_oku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: It's good to have a disaster whistle on hand to call for help during an earthquake.
examples.notes: ⟦{防災|ぼうさい}→防災：07907_bousai⟧⟦{用|よう}→用：noentry⟧の{笛|ふえ} = disaster whistle

notes:
{笛|ふえ} is a general term that covers both musical flutes and signal whistles.

TYPES OF FLUTES:
- ⟦{横笛|よこぶえ}→横笛：22502_yokobue⟧: transverse flute (played sideways)
- ⟦{縦笛|たてぶえ}→縦笛：22668_tatebue⟧: recorder (played vertically) — every Japanese student learns this in school
- ⟦{尺八|しゃくはち}→尺八：04465_shakuhachi⟧: shakuhachi (traditional bamboo flute)
- ⟦フルート→フルート：04462_furuuto⟧: Western concert flute

WHISTLE USAGE:
- ⟦{審判|しんぱん}→審判：03331_shinpan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{笛|ふえ}: referee's whistle
- ⟦{防災|ぼうさい}→防災：07907_bousai⟧⟦{用|よう}→用：noentry⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{笛|ふえ}: emergency whistle

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {笛|ふえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吹|ふ}く→吹く：02445_fuku⟧: to play a flute / to blow a whistle
- {笛|ふえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧: sound of a flute/whistle
- {笛|ふえ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}る→鳴る：01143_naru⟧: a whistle sounds
